research.subject: Tony Tony Chopper
gaps: The abilities page mixes manga, anime, post-Wano material, non-canon material, and video-game material rather than presenting a clean source limited to the requested continuity. Later material and explicitly non-canon or game-only entries were excluded.

The official profile describes an 'astonishing seven-stage transformation,' while the detailed page separately lists Brain, Heavy, Walk, Jumping, Guard, Arm, Horn, Kung Fu, and Monster Point. The exact counting convention for the forms is unresolved.

No complete list of named manga combat attacks is supplied. Chopperphage Nebulizer is supported, but the pages do not establish names for his boxing, wrestling, kung fu, antler, defensive, or Monster Point attacks.
The supplied pages do not establish numerical damage, health, costs, cooldowns, range, targeting rules, unlock progression, or other game-balance values.

A playable kit with at least 15 purchasable upgrades is a game-design request rather than character evidence, and the selected output schema has no upgrade field. No such upgrades are recorded as canon facts.
Medical knowledge, diagnosis, tactical analysis, or battlefield observation do not establish the ability to sense concealed or hidden enemies.
No evidence supports granting global armor-ignore effects, unconditional footwork bonuses, or other modifiers that apply across every affected form.
No evidence supports elemental attacks, elemental status effects, recoil mechanics beyond the specifically described Monster Point aftermath, or unsupported movement modifiers.
The pages do not provide a character-specific account of the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses involving water or seastone, so those weaknesses are not recorded as sourced Chopper-specific claims.
The pages do not establish exact per-form duration, resource cost, range, targeting, or control rules beyond the stated Rumble Ball restrictions and Monster Point durations.
The detailed page contains post-Wano references and claims that are outside the selected endpoint; those claims, including later demon-related material, were omitted.
